target.tool: Customer-verified business interface; master restrictions apply

key.note: Preserve source identifiers in an audit ledger; map regenerated internal IDs and target numbering. Never assume internal IDs survive migration.

structures.preprocessing: Unscoped candidate rows. Approve the full-key population at cutover; use customer-cohort-project.json. Stock is a frozen, reconciled inventory population, including batch and special stock. MARD quantities alone do not establish complete inventory. Physical inventory, valuation, units and currency conversion need business sign-off. Historical goods movements are reference data. Open purchasing scope requires item status, receipts, invoices, deletion, returns and remaining quantities; it is not inferred from the header alone. Migrate general and purchasing-organization data at their separate grains. Supplier/business-partner mapping and units are prerequisites. EINE current net price does not supply complete time-dependent conditions: export the configured purchasing condition tables, KONH/KONP and scales as a linked set with validity, access key and deletion checks. Do not claim complete condition coverage from EINA/EINE alone.
